notes: Ingredient quantities on the cooking panel now always read like a cook wrote them: imported decimals display as fractions (0.33 -> 1/3, 0.67 -> 2/3, 14.5 oz -> 14 1/2 oz, 0.17 -> 1/6) even before you touch the scaler, and genuinely odd decimals stay honest rather than being rounded to a wrong fraction. Percentages are left alone - 2% milk no longer doubles into 4% milk when you scale a recipe up. Also includes the v1.36.1 mobile fixes: the Cooking page's photo row wraps so the Site photos button stays on screen, and recipe action buttons wrap below each recipe on phones.
